imp0rt pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('orders.csv', parse_dates=['created_at'])
# Python: duplicated rows came from a retry in the exporter, so drop on the natural key instead of the full row
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['order_id', 'line_no'], keep='last')
df['total'] = df['qty'] * df['unit_price']
assert df['total'].ge(0).all(), 'negative totals mean refunds leaked into sales'
print(df.groupby('region')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head())
